raw_text: Indian Express — Manipur Violence: At Least 35 Dead as Ethnic Clashes Engulf State, Imphal, May 3, 2023. Manipur is witnessing its worst ethnic violence in decades as clashes between the Meitei majority and Kuki-Zo tribal communities have left at least 35 people dead and over 150 injured across multiple districts. The state capital Imphal is under strict curfew with Army columns conducting flag marches. Thousands have been displaced from both communities, with relief camps being set up in schools and community halls. The Union Home Ministry has dispatched additional paramilitary forces and a senior official to assess the situation. The state government has suspended internet services indefinitely to prevent the spread of inflammatory content.
